mapper.select: /* AppLeave01Mapper.selectExpiringSoon */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS targetCount , MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE) AS nearestExpiryYmd , DATEDIFF( STR_TO_DATE(MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE), '%Y%m%d') , STR_TO_DATE(#{ param.todayYmd }, '%Y%m%d') ) AS daysUntilExpiry , SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) AS totalRemainingDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND G.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) > 0 AND G.AVAIL_TO_DATE BETWEEN #{ param.todayYmd } AND DATE_FORMAT( DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{ param.todayYmd }, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) , '%Y%m%d' )

/* AppLeave01Mapper.selectUser */ SELECT U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(C.CREDIT_MONTHS) FROM TB_USER_SERVICE_CREDIT C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND C.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ), 0) AS serviceCreditMonths FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND U.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd }
